item.title: RimWorld Ideologie-Explorer — Memes & Rituale (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Nutze den RimWorld Ideologie-Explorer, um Memes, Rituale und Glaubensregeln deiner Ideologie zu verstehen — für die aktuelle 1.6 / Odyssey-Version mit der Ideology-Erweiterung. Ideologie Explorer Ideology Precept Explorer Browse precepts by category and pair them with rituals for your ideoligion. Blindness (Honorable) [Sight]Blind pawns get mood bonus + social respect Cannibalism (Accepted) [Food]No mood penalty for eating human meat Slavery (Accepted) [Social]Slaves work without mood penalty Drug use (Intense) [Drugs]Drugs give bigger mood boosts, addiction risk
